notes.title: Fear the Night Full Release
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011139/deb2bfd63e18d87122c8938ff4353e8abe1a5856.png[/img]

Greetings Survivors,

Heads up (or heads off if you’re a zombie)! Fear the Night is entering 1.0 release, with a content update to 1.54326. We appreciate your support and love for [b]Fear the Night[/b] since our launch in Early Access. Let’s continue our zombie hunting together in Fear the Night with the full release! 

Fear the Night full release patch will be available on July 17 at 03:00 am PST. 

[b]North Side of the River
[/b]
[list]
[*] The time has come -  get ready to ride on Big-Cargo and traverse across Murder Island as we head towards the other side of the river where we can try our luck. A meandering maze inside the ultimate cave awaits exploration.
[/list] 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011139/04c8b689b600ffd9ab51a9334ec8cb34464f0fe8.png[/img]

[b]New items[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new environmental item, Emergency Light, which is used to provide lighting and to guide you through the end of the maze. 
[*] Added a new item, Lithium-ion Battery, which is used to power Emergency Light.
[*] Added the remaining nine pages of Survivor’s Notes, uncovering more about what has happened since the zombie outbreak. 
[*] Added a new shelter to the north part of the map.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some glitching terrain 
[/list]

That's it, Survivors. You’ve survived all the hordes and danger up until now, but will you be able to make it to the other side, through the final room of the maze? Good luck~

notes.title: Fear the Night Patch 34.54216
notes.notes:
Greetings Survivors,

We will be pushing a patch 34.54216 on May 8 at 00:00 am PST.

Below you can check the complete list of changes and fixes:

• 	Added Murder Island to the map in Area 11, along with a new cave on the island.
• 	Added a large vehicle, Big-Cargo, together with the items and resource used to craft the Big-Cargo
• 	Added Zobi-Gasoline, the fuel to power up Big-Cargo, and the required items and resources to craft it.
• 	Added Big-Cargo Bench to Area 11. It is where players can craft Big-Cargo and Zobi-Gasoline.
• 	Optimized the collision and terrain of the bridge connected to the Murder Island.
• 	Fixed an issue where structures can be placed inside the spawning cave.

notes.title: Fear the Night Patch 30.53837 March 3rd
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

We will be bringing down the servers on Sunday, March 3rd, at 9PM PST for an update patch. Patch notes can be found below:

[b]Changes/New features[/b]
[list]
[*]Players will now be able to join the zombie horde when the character’s Infection drops to 0 or turns into Infected state, and then gets killed. Players can control their zombified character to attack other players and structures. Character can suicide to respawn as a player character, otherwise he/she will remain zombified. 
[*]Added an on/off switch to determine whether you want to display UA icons in the map.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the first shot from the shotgun was not doing damage to zombies
[*]Fixed an issue where, when logging in, players might spawn in the second floor of a shelter and find no way out.
[*]Fixed an issue where the item "Tablet" was not in the loot table for weapon chests. 
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]

Reduced the difficulty in taking over shelters in earlier zones by reducing the amount of zombies spawned, and reducing the probability of spawning Slith and Joe in the zombie horde.

notes.title: Fear the Night Patch 29. 53778
notes.notes:
Greetings Survivors,

We will be pushing a minor patch today on January 22 at 10:00 pm PST.

Below you can check the complete list of changes:


Fixes
●	Fixed an issue where server restart would automatically set the generators to be on. 
●	Fixed an issue where UA robots getting stuck below the ground could not be teleported up to nearby UA Portal.

Zombies that spawn while attempting to occupy a shelter will be stronger than the zombies in the surrounding area.

notes.title: Fear the Night Patch 28.53753
notes.notes:
Greetings Survivors,

We will be pushing a patch today on January 21 at 10:00 pm PST.

Below you can check the complete list of changes:

Changes
●	Characters offline: when characters are offline, they will no longer be in unconscious states remaining in the servers. Offline characters will be in invisible to other online characters, while the data is saved in the server for you to retrieve next time your log in. 
●	Location of your hacked UA robots will be displayed on the Map.
●	Implemented auto decay for shelter generators: without being damaged by zombies, the auto decay timer for Large Generator is 20 days, Medium Generator 15 days, and Small Generator 10 days, all in real time. Lost durability from the auto decay can be remedied by repairing.


Fixes
●	Fixed some glitching issues and terrain getting players stuck for the Water Treatment Plant and the Gas Station.
●	Fixed an issue where when the amount of placed structures for a single shelter or POI exceeds 500, client might be disconnected to server. 
●	Fixed an issue where the item sorting in the workbenches is incorrect. 
●	Fixed an issue where Gas Motor and Compressor Parts do not salvage into the right items as indicated. Their salvaging time is also reduced. 
●	Fixed an issue where the button for Map is bound to M and any other rebound buttons for it are invalid. 
●	Fixed an issue where Buff icons on HUD do not disappear after the Buff is interrupted. 
●	Fixed an issue where players are unable to retrieve the backpack if their characters die on the slopelike terrains. 
●	Fixed an issue where some zombies are invincible and immobile. 
●	Fixed an issue where that may stuck in the large shelter when fast travel.

notes.title: Fear the Night Patch 26.53677
notes.notes:
Greetings Survivors,

We will be pushing a patch today on January 14 at 6:00 pm PST.

Below you can check the complete list of changes:

[b]Items[/b]
[list]
[*]New item - Wood Door Shield and Metal Door Shield. When you hold RMB to raise your shield, it reduces the damage coming from the front, and you won’t be infected by zombie attacks. 
[*]New item - Sticky Bomb. Throw it at the zombies to cause damage and a slowing effect on them. 
[*]New item - UA Portal. You can use it to teleport your UA robots within a short distance to nearby your UA Portal.  
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]New feature - body beam. Beams are used to indicated the location where your character died last time. When aiming at the body beam, you can press E to pick up your inventory lost in your character’s last death. Up to 3 body beams can be effective at a time.  With the help of body beam, you will be able to retrieve your inventory even if your body falls through the ground. 
[*]Reduced the spawning interval for UA Scout, and unify the spawning interval for UA Enforcer. 
[*]The calculation to determine if your characters are getting the Infection debuff is changed from proportionally to a fixed value, 30. 
[*]Fixed an issue where projectile weapons (like Grenades), where every fifth throw in succession ended up being a dud. 
[/list]

[b]Environment[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some glitching terrain and props that were getting players stuck. 
[*]Fixed some floating trees and props. 
[*]Fixed some glitching terrain inside shelters that are blocking the slots used to place shelter structures. 
[*]Optimized the performance for some environment. 
[*]Fixed the collision issues with the POIs, including Gas Station, Construction Store/Warehouse, and Factory. 
[/list]

[b]Squad[/b]
[list]
[*]New feature: squadmate icons are now shown in different colors in the Map. 
[*]New feature: you can choose to respawn at your squadmates’ shelter now.
[*]Fixed an issue where some players cannot invite other players to form a squad. 
[/list]

[b]Structures[/b]
[list]
[*]New Item - Wood Fence and Wood Fence Door, used to prevent creatures from jumping across and get inside your shelter. 
[*]New feature: automatic door closing. All doors will be closed automatically 3 seconds after they are opened. 
[*]New feature: added multiple directions to Metal Gate’s snapping points when you are building them in succession. 
[*]Reduced the crafting time for some items. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Wired Fence outside lost shelters are not doing damage to zombies. 
[/list]

[b]Others[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where players got disconnected or could not reconnect to the server.
[*]Fixed an issue where your character spawned in game and got stuck in the environment. 
[*]Fixed an issue where your character spawned in game and fell from midair. 
[*]New feature: when respawning or fast traveling, you can click the shelters’ icons on the Map and select your destination instead of going through the respawn point list now. 
[*]Fixed an issue where players are unable to retrieve your inventory in PVP zones. 
[*]Updated some icons.
[/list]

notes.title: Fear the Night Patch 21.53336
notes.notes:
Greeting Survivors,

We will be pushing our patch . Below you can check the complete list of changes in the patch: 

We have changed the UI in Host/Local screen by removing the options, Player Single Player (beta) and Run as Dedicated Server. You can use LAN/Single Player(server) to run a dedicated server and play “single player”. Key in the Server Password, Admin Password and Session Name and click ACCEPT, it will navigate you to the Session screen and point you directly to the LAN filter. Wait for one minute or two for the server to show up, and hit refresh, and then your dedicated server should show up for you to enjoy solo gameplay experience. 

Balance Changes

●	To balance the overall gameplay, POIs and Lairs will be harder now while the loot and drops will be reduced. POI generators will have higher HP.

●	Reduced the percentage of getting rare items when you search safes and police cars.

●	Reduced the protection time for the smaller shelters, so that players who join the server late will have better chance in finding available shelters in earlier areas. 

●	Reduced the night perception to detect players for zombies in later areas, to make it easier for solo players to survive and be safe. 

●	Increased the durability for Stone Axe, Stone Hammer, Wooden Club, Handmade Machete to make it easier for new players to survive. 

●	Adjusted the crafting material for Grenade: fewer Shrapnel and more Gunpowder.

●	Increased Antibiotic ability to restore Infection. 

●	Included Tips to better communicate the need to consume Food and Water to players when fast travelling. 

●	Reduced the salvaging time for Nails. 

●	Adjusted the salvage output for Cutlery to Recycled Metal.

●	Adjusted the animation for Elite zombies to make them smoother in motion. 

●	Adjusted the loot drops for elite zombies. 

Bug Fixes

●	Fixed an issue where passworded dedicated servers are not showing up in Unofficial server list. 

●	Fixed an issue where you cannot place your defense structures outside your shelters due to inappropriate terrain.

●	Fixed an issue where Chained Bat is not repairable. 

●	Fixed some glitching terrains, and some terrains that are getting characters stuck.

●	Fixed some terrains that are getting characters stuck when characters fast traveled.

●	Fixed some glitching terrains in caves. 

●	Fixed an issue where Flavored Fruit Tea cannot be stored in Fridge.

●	Fixed an issue where after you joined the squad with other players, the UI notification is not removed. 

●	Fixed an issue where Tent is getting placed on top of other Tent. 

●	Enabled PIN code for Small Chest.

●	Fixed some glitching trees. 

●	Fixed an issue where Plate Top 2 is not showing the correct crafting material. 

Other Changes

●	Added News in the title screen for posting maintenance notice. 

●	Added Survivor’s Notes to act as our in-game tutorial for players to learn about the basics of Fear The Night. Survivor’s Notes will be available in your inventory whether you are a new player or a continuing player. You can select it and click “Use” to view what is noted down by the veteran survivors. 

●	Changed the default setting for Holding H to show additional character information in HUD to Pressing H to show additional character information. 

●	Updated some in-game icons.  

●	Enabled mouse scroll wheel to scroll up and down in Chat UI.

notes.title: Patch Update - 0.53038
notes.notes:
Greetings Survivors,

We rolled out our first patch addressing the below main concerns:


- Optimized Simplified Chinese localization.
- Fixed an issue where elite zombies will have lagging animation when hit
- Fixed some issues that are likely to cause server rollback.



Thank you for your patience during this stage of development and we hope you are surviving the night!

notes.title: Patch Update - 0.53037 Recent Changes to Single Player
notes.notes:
Greetings Survivors,

We rolled out our first patch addressing two main concerns:

- Fixed a bug that is likely to cause server roll-back

- Single player has been temporarily disabled

The development team has decided not to launch the single player portion of the game in this stage of early access because they felt it just wasn't ready for prime-time, and instead of rushing it out the door, they wanted to take a bit more time to bring things to a state that reflects the vision of the play experience.

 In the meantime, hosting a dedicated server to play single player is a temporary option. 

Details for hosting your own server can be found [url= https://steamcommunity.com/app/764920/discussions/0/1744480332711770246/] here. [/url]

Thank you for your patience during this stage of development and we hope you are surviving the night!
